en.title: Dua Before Sleeping 🐱 | Islamic Manners for Kids | Barakah Buddies #shorts
en.description:
Join Rayyan, Noor and Mishmish the kitten as they learn a beautiful Islamic manner!

Before sleeping, say: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya (With Your name, O Allah, I die and I live).
Source: Sahih al-Bukhari 6324
